During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] served as '''captain''' in the [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[3638 BBY]], he led a refugee caravan named [[Whiteraft]] until he was eliminated by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] forces.<ref name="TOR" />
